Maya: quick async standup — tiny format: 1) what I did 2) blockers 3) today
Sam: 1) prepped bench post draft and spreadsheet with sample prompts (link: https://drive.redwood/bench-drafts)
Sam: 2) blocker — waiting on hero image from Tori (still in review)
Sam: 3) today — finalize draft + QA prompts, want a quick copy pass before scheduling
Tori: 1) exported two hero variations, pushed to Figma, left comments on the CTA layout
Tori: 2) blocker — design signoff depends on legal on claim language, pinged Nora
Tori: 3) today — iterate hero 02 based on feedback, aim to hand off by 3pm PT
Leo: 1) ran small time-of-day benchmark on recent posts (results in sheet, short summary below)
Leo: 1a) peak CTR window looks earlier than we thought (9am-11am PT)
Leo: 2) blocker — need final slug & tracking params from Sam to finish UTM tests
Leo: 3) today — set up scheduled experiment and traffic split for the first 48h if we publish next Tues
Nora: re legal — saw the copy, two tiny edits to the claim: "lower per-token cost" -> "reduced per-token cost for common prompts"
Nora: updated comments in the doc, not a hard stop but prefer we fold it in before publish
Maya: thanks — can we do a quick signoff checklist? Sam/Tori/Nora: reply here with :white_check_mark: when done so I can schedule
Sam: will update slug + UTMs by 11:30am PT and post here, then ready for quick review
Tori: will hand off hero 02 by 2:45pm PT — marking tentative :white_check_mark: (pending legal)
Nora: will add the two-word legal edit and approve final copy by 12:30pm PT :white_check_mark:
Leo: once Sam posts UTMs I’ll finalize experiment config and queue the deploy. ping me if we need a different time window
Maya: small ask — can someone skim the headline? current headline in doc: `Simpler, cheaper LLM inference for production`
Sam: suggestion: `Production-grade LLM inference: faster, cheaper, reliable` (leaner for socials)
Tori: I like Sam's, but might be long for hero. Alternative short: `Faster inference. Lower cost.`
Maya: good options — Sam, drop both into the doc with the two variants and mark which is hero/alt
Sam: done — added hero_alt_A and hero_alt_B in the doc with notes
Maya: deploy-bot — can you confirm availability for a content publish window on Tuesday 9am PT?
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window is clear for Tue 09:00-11:00 PT. No conflicting deploys. Use job ID `deploy-2026-02-15-09` when queuing.
Maya: perfect. last tiny blocker — analytics event for bench posts: event name `bench_publish_v1` needs to be added to trackers. Leo can you confirm?
Leo: yep I added the event to the tracking sheet and gave Sam edit rights. I’ll validate once the UTMs are live
Maya: outstanding items: Sam (UTMs + copy pass), Tori (final hero), Nora (legal edit). If all :white_check_mark: by 1pm PT, I’ll schedule for Tue 9am PT and post draft to social queue
Sam: on it — will post UTMs here when ready :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tori: handing off assets now, uploading final PNGs to the folder :arrow_up_small:
Nora: legal done and approved inline — good to publish from my side :white_check_mark:
Maya: awesome, thanks team. I'll create the scheduled job after Sam confirms UTMs. If anyone sees a last-minute problem ping me @maya or drop here.
Sam: UTMs posted: `?utm_source=redwood-newsletter&utm_campaign=bench-feb26&utm_medium=organic` — ready for review
Leo: UTMs look good. I’ll queue the experiment and set the traffic split to 70/30 for hero variants after deploy
Maya: final check: anyone object to Tue 9am? no objections = go
Sam: no objections :thumbsup:
Tori: no objections :thumbsup:
Nora: no objections :thumbsup:
Maya: green light. scheduling publish now. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :rocket:
deploy-bot: Job `deploy-2026-02-15-09` queued by Maya. ETA publish: 2026-02-15 09:00 PT. Logs will appear in #eng-releases.
